A.notes: The hero has a decent idea—cleanly isolating one log line—but the concept thins out down the page into large empty sections and fairly standard SaaS blocks. The strongest problem is craft on mobile: the measured 180px horizontal overflow matches the cropped, cramped phone view, which makes the page feel unfinished despite passing the basic accessibility checks.

B.notes: This has one clear idea—one illuminated line inside a console-like system—and it carries through the hero, process, product demo, pricing, and install sections. The scroll-strip shows meaningful progression tied to the story, and the measured checks plus the clean mobile view suggest strong implementation discipline with solid reduced-motion fallback.

raw.why: B is more cohesive, more distinctive, and much better resolved on both motion and mobile craft while still meeting the brief cleanly.
